scope: Matched sample/update-budget loss comparison; internal COCO val2017 splits, not official train2017-to-val2017 benchmark

protocol.initialization: same original release checkpoint for every arm
protocol.train_scope: model.12 parameters only, all BN statistics frozen
protocol.detection_normalization: divide native detection loss by batch size
protocol.selection: highest development AP among three sparse trained arms; fixed before final evaluation
protocol.scope: internally split COCO val2017 small experiment, pretraining overlap unknown; not official full COCO benchmark

decision: Both development selections favor pure KD; accuracy is not consistently within 0.3 AP points across seeds/cohorts.
limitations: Two training-order seeds on one fixed data split; no statistical significance claim.
Matched image exposure/update counts do not imply equal training FLOPs or wall time.
Batch changed from prior pilot; do not attribute cross-pilot changes solely to dataset size.
Pretraining overlap unknown; evaluated cohorts become regression/development data for future work.
Telemetry validation timings are not deployment latency.
